subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements is/are correct about reduction?

a) Loss of oxygen

b) Gain of hydrogen

c) Gain of oxygen

d) Loss of hydrogen
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only a and b**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Reduction involves the gain of electrons**, which often corresponds to the gain of hydrogen or the loss of oxygen in a chemical reaction.
 
• **Loss of oxygen** is a key indicator of a reduction reaction.
 
• **Gain of hydrogen** is another common characteristic of reduction.
 
• Oxidation and reduction reactions always occur simultaneously in what are known as **redox reactions**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Oxidation**

 
 
• Oxidation is the process where an atom, ion, or molecule loses electrons.
 
• It is often accompanied by the gain of oxygen or the loss of hydrogen.
 
• Oxidation reactions release energy and are exothermic.
 
 
 
• **Redox Reactions**
 
 
• Redox reactions involve the simultaneous processes of reduction and oxidation.
 
• These reactions are vital for energy production in biological systems, such as cellular respiration.
 
 
 
• **Electrochemical Cells**
 
 
• In electrochemical cells, oxidation occurs at the anode, and reduction occurs at the cathode.
 
• These cells convert chemical energy into electrical energy or vice versa.
 
 
 
• **Importance in Industry**
 
 
• Reduction processes are crucial in metallurgy for extracting metals from their ores.
 
• They are also used in various chemical manufacturing processes.
